final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT t.account_id, d.A3, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) AS net_amount, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(net_amount) AS total_sum FROM step1) SELECT s1.account_id, s1.A3, s1.net_amount, s1.record_count, CAST(s1.net_amount AS REAL) / s2.total_sum AS ratio FROM step1 s1 CROSS JOIN step2 s2 WHERE s2.total_sum IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10
